title: libtmux filter expression
description: A lowered filter expression as a flat sequence in prefix order. Groups, negations, and relations are bracketed by begin and end nodes so a reader never counts operands.

version.description: Schema version. A reader that does not recognise the value must refuse the document rather than guess.

name.description: tmux format name for a test, relation name for a relation.

op.description: Present on string_test and number_test. A number_test uses eq, ne, lt, lte, gt or gte; a string_test uses the rest.

operand.description: The value compared against, owned rather than referenced.

conjunction.description: Present only on begin_group. True is and, false is or.

quantifier.description: Present only on begin_relation: 0 any_of, 1 all_of, 2 none_of, 3 is.

number.description: Present only on number_test: the value compared against, as a number rather than as its rendered text.
